title: Career Roadmap · Seed Inspector
summary: A Seed Inspector checks seed quality, labelling, packaging, sale and compliance with applicable seed laws to help ensure farmers receive seeds that meet prescribed standards.

about.label: Education
about.text: Agriculture / seed science qualification; exact requirements depend on the applicable government recruitment rules.

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Science with Biology or Agriculture, where available.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Biology, chemistry, agriculture, genetics and basic statistics.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: Diploma and degree eligibility varies by institution and recruitment authority.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Seed production, germination, seed purity, crop varieties and agricultural regulations.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Accurate sampling, observation, documentation, laboratory safety and report writing.

items.text: Diploma in Agriculture → Agricultural field and seed-production support; may not meet every inspector-post requirement.
B.Sc. Agriculture → Relevant foundation for seed science, crop production and agricultural regulation.
B.Sc. Horticulture → Relevant to horticultural seed production; eligibility for inspector posts must be checked.
M.Sc. Seed Science & Technology / Agronomy → Advanced seed quality, testing and research opportunities.
Agricultural laboratory training → Useful practical preparation, but not a substitute for required statutory eligibility.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Seed Inspector is a regulated statutory role. Under India’s Seeds Rules, the prescribed qualification and appointment conditions matter; a diploma alone should not be assumed sufficient. Verify the current notification issued by the relevant state or central authority.

Critical eligibility note
blocks.text: Rule 22 of the Seeds Rules, 1968, in the available published text, specifies a graduate in Agriculture from a recognised university plus at least one year of experience in seed production, seed development, seed analysis or seed testing in a seed-testing laboratory. Verify the current applicable rules and recruitment notification before planning around this requirement.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic transcripts, subject prerequisites, English proficiency where required, proof of funding and student-visa documentation. Verify current programme-specific admission rules.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Seed Quality Technician, Seed Testing Technician, Seed Production Technician, Seed Quality Assurance Specialist.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Seed companies, agricultural laboratories, crop research, plant breeding and quality assurance.
The statutory title Seed Inspector and its legal powers are country-specific. An Indian qualification does not automatically authorise regulatory inspection abroad.
